summary: Descriptive-metadata correction for the five homeowner legal chargebacks posted by Approve Treatment (Canyon Gate invoice 283101 x4, Waterview PS-INV350881 x1): the owner-facing description becomes category + catalogue service phrase + "(Attorney Inv. <ref>)", raw_row_jsonb gains the item/allocation links and the reference, tenure_id is stamped with the approved owner (still current), and each upload batch label follows. No amount, date, category, GL, posting or allocation changes; no rows added or removed.

preflight.name: exactly five owner charges came from Approve Treatment
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions WHERE raw_row_jsonb->>'source' = 'legal_invoice_review'

preflight.name: the five rows still carry their reviewed description and amount
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions h JOIN (VALUES ('14286fec-5e96-4644-8f40-8c625403ae0b'::uuid, 100800, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('513cfe4b-0538-499f-bdf1-6b4e69ad8ee2'::uuid, 3200, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('e4c92b73-f31c-422a-9804-35edba863dbc'::uuid, 3200, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('e9195994-6fb8-41c5-b6d6-97f15e413516'::uuid, 6800, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('5fce468b-9bc0-4109-8cf8-158ae5be7733'::uuid, 55735, 'Legal Fees - DRV Enforcement / PS-INV350881')) v(id, amt, d) ON v.id = h.id AND v.amt = h.amount_cents AND v.d = h.description

preflight.name: the five total 169735 cents
preflight.sql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount_cents), 0)::bigint FROM homeowner_transactions WHERE id IN ('14286fec-5e96-4644-8f40-8c625403ae0b'::uuid, '513cfe4b-0538-499f-bdf1-6b4e69ad8ee2'::uuid, 'e4c92b73-f31c-422a-9804-35edba863dbc'::uuid, 'e9195994-6fb8-41c5-b6d6-97f15e413516'::uuid, '5fce468b-9bc0-4109-8cf8-158ae5be7733'::uuid)

preflight.name: each is linked from exactly one posted legal posting

preflight.name: none is stamped with a tenure yet

preflight.name: each posting's owner is still the property's current owner
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions h JOIN legal_invoice_postings p ON p.homeowner_transaction_id = h.id JOIN ownership_tenures t ON t.id = p.tenure_id AND t.property_id = h.property_id AND t.kind = 'owner' AND t.end_date IS NULL WHERE h.id IN ('14286fec-5e96-4644-8f40-8c625403ae0b'::uuid, '513cfe4b-0538-499f-bdf1-6b4e69ad8ee2'::uuid, 'e4c92b73-f31c-422a-9804-35edba863dbc'::uuid, 'e9195994-6fb8-41c5-b6d6-97f15e413516'::uuid, '5fce468b-9bc0-4109-8cf8-158ae5be7733'::uuid)

preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM transaction_upload_batches b JOIN homeowner_transactions h ON h.source_batch_id = b.id WHERE h.id IN ('14286fec-5e96-4644-8f40-8c625403ae0b'::uuid, '513cfe4b-0538-499f-bdf1-6b4e69ad8ee2'::uuid, 'e4c92b73-f31c-422a-9804-35edba863dbc'::uuid, 'e9195994-6fb8-41c5-b6d6-97f15e413516'::uuid, '5fce468b-9bc0-4109-8cf8-158ae5be7733'::uuid) AND b.period_label = left(h.description, 60)
